semiconductor_relevance: High — IRIE KOKEN specializes in vacuum gate valves and non-evaporative getter pumps, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: IRIE KOKEN develops advanced vacuum gate valves with switchable sealing directions and non-evaporative getter pumps that maintain ultra-high vacuum conditions. Their products are designed to enhance operational efficiency in semiconductor fabrication and related fields.
capabilities: Vacuum gate valves with switchable sealing direction
Non-evaporative getter pumps for ultra-high vacuum applications
Molded bellows with non-evaporative getter properties
Automatic lifting mechanisms for welded bellows
